actor: Independent AI read-only product reviewer; no human, host E2E or publication reviewer
method: Read source and contracts, reproduce concrete failures in temporary synthetic archives and local prefixes, notify implementation agent, then rerun independent adversarial checks after source freeze. No product or parent-owned documentation edits.

initialFindings.initialReproduction: A complete self-consistent tar inventory containing regular files foo and foo/bar passed read_bundle. install wrote foo and then raised FileExistsError on foo/bar, leaving releases/0.1.0-beta.1 in the final location.
initialFindings.resolution: validate_bundle_metadata rejects parent/file path collisions before materialization; install uses an exclusive staging tree with verification before final rename.
initialFindings.finalCase: archive rejects file/directory prefix collision before extraction

initialFindings.initialReproduction: A bundle with complete outer hashes but an inner release manifest runtimeSource=forbidden-other-tree passed read_bundle, then install wrote the final version directory before metadata verification failed. Final directory remained.
initialFindings.resolution: read_bundle validates inner release metadata and artifact hashes before any write. install verifies its own staging tree, then renames it; failed staging cleans only its own temporary tree.
finalCases: failed inner-release validation leaves no installed version
failed staging removes only its own temporary tree

initialFindings.initialReproduction: Top-level bundle manifest [] raised AttributeError and files=[[]] raised TypeError rather than a clean ValueError.
initialFindings.resolution: validate_bundle_metadata now checks the manifest, version, inventory row shape, digest and literal integer byte count before use.
finalCases: manifest malformed shape 0 is cleanly rejected
manifest malformed shape 2 is cleanly rejected
manifest malformed shape 3 is cleanly rejected

initialFindings.initialReproduction: A self-consistent archive containing inner release schema {"type": []} reached validate_schema and raised TypeError: unhashable type list.
initialFindings.resolution: validate_schema rejects unsupported type and malformed vocabulary structures; inner metadata separately verifies rows/artifacts and conservative scope even if its bundled schema is weakened.
finalCases: inner schema invalid-type-array is cleanly rejected
weakening inner schema cannot forge three-host E2E

initialFindings.initialReproduction: The initial 6-test release run had 4 failures: stale schema hash in the manifest, and 3 diagnostic substring expectations after schema validation was added.
initialFindings.resolution: Final manifest hashes and tests agree with schema diagnostics; the final 29-test release/bundle/preflight suite passes.

initialEvidenceLimit: Initial failures were observed directly in tool output and reported to Root and the implementation agent. The first pre-fix input bytes were not saved or hashed; this report does not claim a replayable sealed pre-fix snapshot. The independent final audit is replayable and hash-bound.
additionalFinalChecks: Reject parent traversal, absolute paths, tar symlinks and hard links before extraction.
Refuse unknown current symlinks, unrecognized activation files and stale activation temporary symlinks; user bytes are preserved.
Reject forged three-host E2E claims in archives and installed metadata; host rows remain not-tested.
Upgrade and rollback preserve both version payloads and change the registered current pointer.
Current source inputs remained byte-identical throughout the independent audit.
limits: Synthetic minimum payloads verify safety boundaries; they do not prove completeness or user usability of the real beta archive.
The product suite performs a real pack/extraction/three-fixture standalone analysis; it is not a three-host E2E run, a model execution, a human study or a publication approval.
Archive checksum inventory detects inconsistent bytes; it is not a publisher authenticity signature.

This review covers offline local installation contracts. Activation updates a symlink and state receipt as separate filesystem operations; it does not certify crash durability or OS-level concurrent adversarial races.
M4 remains partial and M5 remains in_progress. No public release is declared.
